name: Visual Analog Scale
description: 100 mm horizontal line anchored at 'no pain' (0) and 'worst pain imaginable' (100 mm). Patient marks their pain level.
shirleySays: MDC: ~11 mm. MCID: 9–11 mm (acute pain); 15 mm (chronic pain). SEM ~7 mm. High responsiveness (SRM 0.8+). Requires pen/paper or digital slider; less reliable with motor/cognitive impairment. Well-normed in oncology, post-op, LBP, neck pain, and fibromyalgia populations.
